da dunda de
da dunda de di</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE GIVES.
HE GIVES IT.
HE, GIVES IT TO HIM.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da se dunda
ETC.</p>
| <br />

|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da te dunda
ETC.</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE IS A RECIPIENT.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da ca dunda

HE GAVE.

|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da pu pu dunda

</p>

|- valign="TOP"

|- valign="TOP"

<center>
{| class='wikitable'
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="LEFT">'''Lojban GRAMMAR''' derives great flexibility and variety from manipulation of [[cmavo|tense particles]] that do much of its work. As demonstrated here, it is the particles that determine whether a predicate—a term of extralinguistic reference, such as '''dunda''' and '''bajra'''—is to serve in a given statement as a noun, verb, adjective or adverb, as in more familiar grammars. Thus '''pu'''(''before''), '''ca''' (''now'') and '''ba''' (''after'') give the predicate '''dunda''' (''to give'') the function of a verb  (upper left)  and "conjugate" it through the future, present and past tense. Compound forms of these operators yield the compound tenses;</p>
| <br />
| <p align="LEFT">for example, '''pu pu''' (''before-before'') indicates the pluperfect tense. In such combinations they not only duplicate all of the familiar grammatical forms but go far beyond to express relationships that can be only clumsily approximated in the natural languages, as is indicated by the translation of the compound operator '''ba zi ze'u''' at center left. The flexibility of the system is suggested further by the transformations of '''dunda''' (in this table ''give'', ''giver'', ''gift'', ''generous'', ''generously'', ''generosity'', and so on) in accord with its association with operators and connectives or its place in a multiple predicate.</p>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| class='wikitable'
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">''''''"'''ADVERB"''' '''FORMS'''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da ro roi dunda
da so'e roi dunda
da so'o roi dunda
ETC.</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | HE ALWAYS GIVES. 
HE USUALLY GIVES. 
HE SOMETIMES GIVES.
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da pu zi dunda
da pu zu dunda
da ba zi dunda
</p>
| <br />
| HE RECENTLY GAVE. 
HE GAVE LONG AGO. 
HE WILL SOON GIVE.
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da vi dunda
da va dunda
da vu dunda</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | HE GIVES HERE. 
HE GIVES THERE. 
HE GIVES OVER THERE.
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da bu'u ro de dunda
</p>
| <br />
| HE GIVES EVERYWHERE (IN ALL PLACES).
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da ba zi ze'u vi dunda
</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | SOON HE WILL BE GIVING HERE FOR A LONG TIME.
|}
</center>

<center>

<center>
{| class='wikitable'
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">'''COMPOUND FORMS'''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da bajra gi'a cadzu
da bajra gi'e cadzu</p>

|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da a de bajra
da e de bajra</p>

| HE1 OR HE2 RUNS. 
HE1 AND HE2 RUNS
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da bajra i ja de cadzu
da bajra i je de cadzu
da bajra i babo de cadzu
da bajra i jo de cadzu</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | HE1 RUNS OR HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS AND HE2 WALKS, 
IF HE1 RUNS THEN HE2 WALKS.

|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da bajra ki'u lo nu de cadzu
da bajra tai lo nu de cadzu</p>
| <br />
| HE1 RUNS BECAUSE HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS LIKE HE2 WALKS.
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">ki'u lo nu da cadzu vau da bajra</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | BECAUSE HE2 WALKS, HE1 RUNS.
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da bajra ca lo nu de cadzu
da bajra ba lo nu de cadzu
da bajra bu'u lo nu de cadzu
ETC.</p>
| <br />
| HE1 RUNS WHEN HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS AFTER HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS WHERE HE2 WALKS,
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">ca lo nu de cadzu vau de bajra</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | WHEN HE2 WALKS HE1 RUNS.
|}
</center>
